title: PAM Workflow Guide
text: pamflow R package automates entire pipeline passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) birds (vocalizing animal). point folder field recordings spreadsheet deployment dates, : Reads quality-checks every audio file Optionally filters low-frequency noise Runs custom BirdNET deep-learning classifier detect species Cleans raw detections (removes false positives, merges overlapping calls) Lets validate detector accuracy interactive web app Builds occupancy detection histories ready statistical modelling Generates HTML, PDF, Excel reports Everything resumable (crashes, picks left ), reproducible (one config file controls settings), robust (one bad file never kills whole run).

title: PAM Workflow Guide
text: Q: Can resume crashed detection run? Yes. Rerun pam_detect(cfg, run_id = "run01"). reads checkpoint skips completed files. Q: change confidence threshold? Edit processing.min_confidence config rerun Stage 4. need rerun Stage 3. Q: Can add species model later? Yes. Replace model files rerun Stage 3 new run_id. Q: filenames don’t match default pattern? Change filenames.pattern config using named capture groups: (?<grid>...), (?<date>...), (?<time>...). Q: much disk space need? Original audio + filtered copies (filtering) + detection CSVs. 1 TB audio, budget ~2.1 TB total. Q: Can run Mac Linux? Yes. Install FFmpeg via package manager (brew install ffmpeg apt install ffmpeg).
